subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined phrase.

Jared __deliberately set fire to a property__ and got arrested by the police.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"arson"** means the criminal act of deliberately setting fire to property. (आगजनी)
 
 
• **Example: **The police arrested the man for committing arson at the abandoned warehouse.
 
 
 
• **"Arson" **involves the intentional setting of fires to cause damage or destruction, typically to buildings or property. (आगजनी)
 
 
• **Example: **He was charged with multiple counts of arson after the investigation revealed he had set fire to several buildings.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dystrophy **(दुर्बलता): A disorder in which an organ or tissue of the body wastes away.
 
 
• **Example:** Muscular dystrophy is a genetic condition that causes progressive muscle weakness.
 
 
 
• **Insomnia **(अनिद्रा ): The condition of being unable to sleep.
 
 
• **Example: **She has been suffering from insomnia for several months and struggles to get a good night's sleep.
 
 
 
• **Dementia** (मनोभ्रंश): A chronic or persistent disorder of the mental processes caused by brain disease or injury.
 
 
• **Example:** Alzheimer's disease is the most common cause of dementia in older adults.
 
 

Question: Jared deliberately set fire to a property and got arrested by the police.

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
